card.architecture: HiDream-I1 17B MoE DiT (quad encoder: CLIP-L + CLIP-G + T5-XXL + Llama-3.1-8B)
card.summary: 17B sparse-MoE model, the Full (highest-quality) variant. Four text encoders give very strong prompt adherence; real CFG + negative prompts. Heaviest still-image model here.
use_cases: detailed general generation with negative control
card.pick_when: You want maximum prompt adherence on a 24 GB card and can accept ~50 steps.

prompt.guidance: Detailed natural-language prose. Full variant uses real CFG (~5) and a negative prompt.
prompt.example: A grand library with floating books, warm shafts of light through tall windows, a small dragon perched on a ladder, intricate, cinematic
prompt.instructions: Write rich natural language; the four encoders reward detail and relational description. Full: ~50 steps, cfg 5, uni_pc/simple, flow-shift 3. Negative prompts are effective.

speed.measured_note: 17B MoE Q5_K_M, ~50 steps; not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in detail. Follows instructions very closely; slower.
